- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the ::notice:: echo at line 21233. Wrap it in `if [ "${answered}" != "true" ]`. Reword it to "this check will not expire its hold again on this issue (even after re-planning); reply /approved to implement the held plan, or close it". The test prefix stays the same. Estimated 3 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
- Other notes: no security issue, because `${issue_num}` is validated against `^[0-9]+$` and the gate is not called inside a command substitution. No naming or backward-compatibility issue. No task gaps: all Phase 7 deliverables are present.

  WHY: Following the advice does not stop the notice. The re-held plan never expiring is documented "never closed again" behaviour, so the defect is the wording, not the keep.
